slides.title: You yank it off the floor.
slides.body: Arms loose, hips shoot up, back rounds. The bar was always winning that one.

slides.title: Pull the slack out first.
slides.body: Squeeze the bar up into the plates until it clicks. Then it leaves the floor.

slides.title: Push the floor. Don't pull the bar.
slides.body: Legs drive it up. Your back's only job is to hold its shape.

slides.title: Hips rising first?
slides.body: Your chest is lagging behind. Set up tighter and keep both rising together.

slides.title: Keep the bar on your shins.
slides.body: Lats on, armpits down. A bar that drifts forward gets heavier every centimetre.

slides.title: Slow start. Fast finish.
slides.body: The first inch off the floor sets up every inch after it. Rush it and you pay for the whole rep.
